```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-coordcube-proximity
#| fig-cap: "Proximity path generation throughput: manual CoordPath vs CoordCube"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

radii = [0, 1, 2, 3, 5]

# Throughput in Melem/s
# Manual: nested for-loops, pure CoordPath construction (no CoordCube API)
manual = [671, 1169, 1295, 1273, 1175]
# Cube count: CoordCube::proximity().count() (generation only, no Vec)
cgen   = [926, 865, 696, 637, 602]
# Cube collect: CoordCube::proximity().collect::<Vec>() (generation + Vec alloc + push)
cvec   = [60.6, 103.9, 197.8, 265.5, 365.1]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

ax.plot(radii, manual, 'o-', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='black',
        markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='Manual CoordPath loop')
ax.plot(radii, cgen, 's--', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='black',
        markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='CoordCube count() (no Vec)')
ax.plot(radii, cvec, '^:', color='black', markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor='black',
        markersize=7, linewidth=1.5, label='CoordCube collect() (with Vec)')

ax.set_xlabel('Proximity radius', fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('Throughput (Melem/s)', fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(radii)
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='lower right')
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)

# Label data points
for r, m, g, v in zip(radii, manual, cgen, cvec):
    ax.text(r, m * 1.3, f'{m:.0f}', fontsize=6, ha='center', va='bottom', color='black')
    ax.text(r, g * 1.3, f'{g:.0f}', fontsize=6, ha='center', va='bottom', color='gray')
    ax.text(r, v * 1.8, f'{v:.0f}', fontsize=6, ha='center', va='bottom', color='gray')

ax.annotate('CoordPath baseline\n(no API overhead)', xy=(2.5, 1300), fontsize=7, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))
ax.annotate('CoordCube API\noverhead', xy=(4.0, 800), fontsize=7, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))
ax.annotate('CoordCube +\nVec alloc/push', xy=(4.0, 250), fontsize=7, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85))

plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
